name: Geometry-aware Gaussian Splatting
definition: A geometry-aware Gaussian Splatting method that initializes thin Gaussians aligned with surfaces in smoothly connected areas and uses constrained optimization to preserve scene geometry and texture, particularly in low-textured regions.
summary: Geometry-aware Gaussian Splatting initializes thin Gaussians aligned with surface normals to preserve geometry and texture, ensuring densification occurs within the tangent plane rather than randomly in 3D space.
